accurate.name: Accurate
accurate.rule: Gain +1 on attack rolls made at Far or Very Far range.

adaptive.name: Adaptive
adaptive.rule: Once per scene, change this weapon’s damage type to Physical, Energy, Void, or Neural until changed again.

agony.name: Agony
agony.rule: After HP or Stress loss, the target makes an Instinct Reaction Roll, DC 15. On failure apply the Core Stunned condition. A target immune to pain ignores this property.

anchoring.name: Anchoring
anchoring.rule: On a hit, the target cannot take Move actions on their next Spotlight unless they succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll against the weapon's Feature DC.

anti-psionic.name: Anti-Psionic
anti-psionic.rule: Add +1d6 Neural damage against a target with a printed Veil-Touched or Veil-Aligned trait, or a target that has activated a Domain Power since the end of its previous Spotlight. While the weapon is drawn, the wielder has Advantage on Instinct and Presence Reaction Rolls against Domain Powers; it grants no immunity and does not alter ordinary Neural attacks.

anti-tech.name: Anti-Tech
anti-tech.rule: Target classification only: the item's Disabling effect may target Synthetics, drones, augmentations, and exposed devices. It grants no additional damage.

anti-vehicle.name: Anti-Vehicle
anti-vehicle.rule: Deals double damage to vehicles and structures. Deals normal damage to personnel.

arc.name: Arc
arc.rule: On a successful hit, the attack arcs to a second target within Very Close range of the first. The second target takes half damage (rounded down).

arcing-shot.name: Arcing Shot
arcing-shot.rule: Ignore cover when there is a clear vertical or indirect trajectory to the target.

area.name: Area
area.rule: The effect applies to every creature in its listed area, including allies, rather than to a single target.

area-band.name: Area
area-band.rule: On detonation or activation, every creature in the printed band makes an Agility Reaction Roll against the item's Feature DC. Failure takes the listed damage or effect in full; success takes half damage and no secondary Condition. Total Cover blocks it.

armor-eating.name: Armor-Eating
armor-eating.rule: The first time each round this item causes HP loss with Acid- or Corrosive-tagged Energy damage, reduce the target's maximum Armor Slots by 1, minimum 0, until Repair All Armor. Additional damage from this item that round does not reduce it again. The Very Close acid zone lingers for 2 rounds under the Lingering procedure above.

armor-piercing.name: Armor Piercing
armor-piercing.rule: Reduce the target’s maximum Armor Slots by the listed rating until its next Long Rest. Multiple applications stack.

assassination.name: Assassination
assassination.rule: An attack against an unaware target has Advantage. On a hit, add one normal weapon damage die and make the target Dazed. A Critical Success doubles the normal pool before this one extra die; damage is never tripled.

attachment.name: Attachment
attachment.rule: This is not a standalone weapon; it attaches to a rifle or carbine with appropriate rail space. The combined weight increases the base weapon's Burden by the amount listed.

automatic.name: Automatic
automatic.rule: After a successful attack, mark 1 Stress to apply the same attack result to a second valid target within range and Very Close of the primary target. Roll damage separately.

biometric.name: Biometric
biometric.rule: The weapon fires only for a registered user. Reprogramming it takes an Action, suitable access, and a Knowledge (Tech) Roll, DC 15. Any success adds or removes one registered user. Failure with Hope changes nothing. Failure with Fear leaves it locked until Downtime repair and alerts the registered owner only if an established network connection exists.

black-hole.name: Black Hole
black-hole.rule: On detonation, every creature within Very Close range makes a Strength Reaction Roll, DC 15. On failure it is pulled to the center and takes 4d6 Void damage; on success it holds position and takes half. Unattended ordinary objects in the zone are destroyed.

blast.name: Blast
blast.rule: Blast and Area (band) mean the Core Explosive procedure in the printed band: every creature there makes an Agility Reaction Roll against the item's Feature DC; failure takes the printed damage or effect in full, success takes half damage and no secondary Condition, and Total Cover blocks it.

bleed.name: Bleeding
bleed.rule: The target gains the Core Bleeding condition: mark 1 Stress at the end of each round until First Aid or any healing effect stops it.

breaching.name: Breaching
breaching.rule: Designed to defeat structural barriers. Ignores Hardness of doors, walls, and similar obstacles up to Tier 3. Against Tier 4 structures, deals half damage. Tier 5 (bunker-grade) structures require specialized charges.

brittle.name: Brittle
brittle.rule: A target that loses HP is left Brittle: the next instance of Physical damage it takes deals +1d6 damage, then Brittle ends. This is not the Vulnerable condition and does not grant Advantage.

burst-fire.name: Burst Fire
burst-fire.rule: Whenever a damage die rolls its maximum value, roll one additional die of the same size and add it. Additional dice do not explode again.

catastrophic.name: Catastrophic
catastrophic.rule: On Failure with Fear while using the item, it becomes Broken and detonates. The user and every creature within Very Close range make Agility Reaction Rolls, DC 15, taking 3d6 Energy damage on failure or half on success. Matching dice remain Critical Success.

charge.name: Charge
charge.rule: Charge means Charge-Up only when the item prints Charge-Up; ordinary references to a battery charge are not a property.

charge-up.name: Charge-Up
charge-up.rule: Spend one Action to charge the weapon. It may fire on a later Spotlight. The charge ends after the shot, if the wielder takes HP damage, or if the weapon leaves the wielder's control.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.rule: After a successful Melee hit, immediately make one additional attack against a different target within this weapon’s reach.

collapsible.name: Collapsible
collapsible.rule: The weapon can fold down to approximately datapad size. While collapsed, it gains the [CR] Concealable property. Deploying or collapsing it is part of a weapon swap when the fiction permits; otherwise it is a Maneuver.

concealable.name: Concealable
concealable.rule: While concealed on the body, this weapon does not count toward Burden. A routine search finds it only on a successful Instinct Roll, DC 15.

cone.name: Cone
cone.rule: Cone uses the Spray procedure: choose a Very Close cone within the weapon's printed range, make one attack Roll, compare it with every creature's Evasion, and roll damage once for every target hit; allies are valid targets.

continuous.name: Continuous
continuous.rule: The target marks 1 Stress at the start of its next Spotlight.

crushing.name: Crushing
crushing.rule: The hit ignores one Armor Slot. Its base type is Physical unless stated.

curse.name: Curse
curse.rule: Curse is a portrayal marker unless the table has adopted Chapter 18's complete Corruption module. By itself it causes no resource loss, compulsion, memory loss, or mechanical penalty.

cursed.name: Cursed
cursed.rule: This weapon has a Precursor curse. See Chapter 18 for curse mechanics.

cutting.name: Cutting
cutting.rule: Armor Slots cannot be spent to reduce this instance of damage.

defensive.name: Defensive
defensive.rule: While wielding this weapon, gain +1 Evasion against Melee attacks.

deployable-cover.name: Deployable Cover
deployable-cover.rule: Deploy a one-way energy wall approximately 5 m × 3 m. It grants Total Cover (Chapter 10) from one side and has 10 HP and 6 Armor Slots. It lasts for the scene or until destroyed.

devastating.name: Devastating
devastating.rule: When damage equals or exceeds the target’s Severe Threshold, the hit marks 1 additional HP.

disabling.name: Disabling
disabling.rule: After the item causes HP loss to a Synthetic, drone, augmentation, or exposed device, its operator makes a Knowledge (Tech) Reaction Roll, DC 15. On failure one fictionally exposed device goes offline until an Action and Knowledge (Tech), DC 15, restores it. Against an unaugmented organic target it has no extra effect.

discriminating.name: Discriminating
discriminating.rule: The mine contains sensors that can distinguish between targets based on programmed parameters: IFF transponder codes, thermal signatures, species identification, or other criteria. The mine only detonates when valid targets enter its trigger radius; it ignores invalid targets.

disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
disintegrate.rule: A target reduced to 0 HP becomes Dying normally. If it later dies before stabilization, no recoverable body remains. This property never skips Dying, Final, or the player's Death Move choice.

disintegrating.name: Disintegrating
disintegrating.rule: When any damage die rolls its maximum value, the target's player chooses one fictionally exposed carried item to go offline or reduces maximum Armor Slots by 1 until Repair All Armor; for an NPC, the Keeper chooses. Restore an offline item with suitable tools during a Short or Long Rest and a successful Knowledge (Tech) Roll, DC 15. A target reduced to 0 HP becomes Dying normally. If it later dies before stabilization, no recoverable body remains. This never skips Final or the voluntary Death Move.

dispersal-wave.name: Dispersal Wave
dispersal-wave.rule: The effect fills a Close-range cone. Each creature in the cone makes a Presence Reaction Roll, DC 15; on failure it suffers the weapon’s listed effect. Resistance: Presence vs DC 15.

disruptor.name: Disruptor
disruptor.rule: Against a Synthetic, drone, or exposed electronic device, roll one additional normal damage die. Against other targets, use the printed damage without modification. If the hit causes HP loss to a Synthetic or drone, one fictionally exposed device goes offline until the end of its next Spotlight.

disturbing.name: Disturbing
disturbing.rule: Legal, origin, and portrayal classifications only. They have no unstated mechanical effect.

emp.name: EMP
emp.rule: On hit, resolve the complete EMP pulse procedure in Chapter 5 against every exposed electronic device, augmentation user, drone, vehicle, and Synthetic within Very Close range. Friendly and hostile systems are affected equally.

energy.name: Energy
energy.rule: This is an Energy weapon. Energy damage treats the target’s Major and Severe Thresholds as 2 lower. The damage line remains the authoritative damage type.

energy-surge.name: Energy Surge
energy-surge.rule: Deal +1d6 Energy damage and the target marks 1 Stress.

entangling.name: Entangling
entangling.rule: After a hit causes HP or Stress loss, the target makes a Strength Reaction Roll against the weapon's Feature DC. On failure it becomes Restrained under the normal Core condition. Resistance: Strength vs Feature DC.

entrapping.name: Entrapping
entrapping.rule: On a hit, the target chooses Strength or Knowledge (Tech) and makes a Reaction Roll against the weapon's Feature DC. On failure it becomes Incapacitated. The condition clears as Chapter 10 defines it. Resistance: Strength or Knowledge (Tech) vs Feature DC.

existence.name: Existence
existence.rule: This is a descriptive Precursor tag, not an independent effect. The item entry must define its exact trigger, target, effect, duration, and end condition before use; without that complete entry, Existence has no mechanical effect.

explosive.name: Explosive
explosive.rule: This is a delivery procedure, not a damage line: the item’s own listed damage is what lands. Every creature within Very Close of the impact point makes an Agility Reaction Roll against the item’s Feature DC. On a failure it takes the item’s listed damage in full; on a success, half. Total Cover blocks the blast. Resistance: Agility vs Feature DC.

finesse.name: Finesse
finesse.rule: Finesse confirms that the attack may use the Finesse Trait even where the fiction would otherwise require Strength. It grants no numeric bonus and never means Agility.

forbidden.name: Forbidden
forbidden.rule: Legal, origin, and portrayal classifications only. They have no unstated mechanical effect.

fragile.name: Fragile
fragile.rule: When a printed degradation trigger occurs under the adopted Condition Track, this weapon degrades two steps instead of one. If that optional module is inactive, Fragile has no mechanical effect.

garrote.name: Garrote
garrote.rule: This weapon may attack only a target that is unaware of the wielder or Restrained by the wielder. Against an unaware target the attack has Advantage; on a hit add one normal weapon damage die. Matching dice alone create a Critical Success and use the normal player or Keeper critical procedure.

genocide.name: Genocide
genocide.rule: Legal and narrative classification only. It grants no mechanical targeting or damage effect unless a campaign device defines a complete, consent-safe procedure.

guided.name: Guided
guided.rule: You may attack a target you are aware of within range without direct line of sight. Guided attacks ignore cover except a completely sealed barrier or other Total Cover that leaves no viable path.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.rule: Heavy on a personal weapon requires Strength +1 or higher; otherwise its attacks have Disadvantage. It has no naval effect and is distinct from a Heavy armor weight tag.

high-recoil.name: High-Recoil
high-recoil.rule: If the wielder has Strength 0 or lower, they suffer 1 Stress after firing.

horrifying.name: Horrifying
horrifying.rule: The first time each scene a creature sees this item cause HP loss, it makes a Presence Reaction Roll, DC 15. On failure it marks 1 Stress. A creature rolls at most once per Horrifying item per scene.

ignite.name: Ignite
ignite.rule: A target that loses HP is On Fire. The condition itself works exactly as Chapter 10 defines it.

indirect.name: Indirect
indirect.rule: An Indirect personal weapon can target enemies without direct line of sight when the shooter has a spotter, personal tracking data, or established knowledge of the target's location. The attack still rolls against Evasion. Personal tracking data is not a Sensor Lock, does not create one, and does not grant Sensor Lock's Advantage.

intimidating.name: Intimidating
intimidating.rule: Grants +1 on Presence Rolls made for social interaction to threaten, coerce, or frighten while visibly wielding this weapon.

irradiating.name: Irradiating
irradiating.rule: After Energy damage with the Radiation tag causes HP loss, the target makes a Strength Reaction Roll, DC 15. On failure it becomes Poisoned until a Knowledge (Medicine) Roll, DC 20, during a Long Rest or Tier 2+ medical care clears it. The impacted Very Close zone remains contaminated until decontaminated with an Action and Knowledge (Tech), DC 15.

jamming.name: Jamming
jamming.rule: Creates a field that blocks wireless communications, radio, data transmission, remote detonation signals. Creatures within the zone cannot communicate with creatures outside except by voice. Remote-controlled devices within the zone cannot receive commands.

knockdown.name: Knockdown
knockdown.rule: On a hit, the target chooses Agility or Strength and makes a Reaction Roll: DC 10 for a Tier 1-2 weapon, or DC 15 for a Tier 3-4 weapon. On failure, the target is Prone.

lethal-toxin.name: Lethal Toxin
lethal-toxin.rule: After a hit causes HP loss, an organic target makes a Strength Reaction Roll, DC 15. On failure it becomes Incapacitated and Poisoned. A second failed Reaction while both conditions remain makes it Dying; stabilize normally at DC 15. Synthetics are immune. Matching dice remain Critical Success.

lightweight.name: Lightweight
lightweight.rule: This weapon does not count toward Burden. A one-handed Lightweight weapon may be used comfortably in the off hand, but does not grant an extra attack.

linear.name: Linear
linear.rule: The charge cuts a line no longer than Very Close range instead of creating a blast. The plasma jet creates one opening along that declared line.

lingering.name: Lingering
lingering.rule: The impacted zone remains hazardous for N rounds; an unnumbered Lingering lasts until the end of the next round. Entering or beginning a Spotlight there repeats the normal Area Reaction against half the printed damage dice, rounded down to at least one die. Resolve it at most once per Spotlight and mark remaining rounds visibly.

loud.name: Loud
loud.rule: Firing this weapon alerts every creature in the current scene and in one adjacent accessible zone. It cannot accept a silencer. Creatures farther away notice it only when the fiction has an unobstructed acoustic or sensor path.

massive.name: Massive
massive.rule: The wielder suffers -1 Evasion. On a hit, roll one additional normal damage die and discard the lowest normal damage die before totaling damage.

melting.name: Melting
melting.rule: After a hit causes HP loss, place one Melting marker on the target. At the start of that target's next Spotlight, it makes a Strength Reaction Roll against the weapon's Feature DC. On failure, roll one normal die of the weapon's printed damage and apply it as Energy damage with the same Fire, Thermal, Acid, or Corrosive tag; on success, apply half that roll. Then clear the marker.

messy.name: Messy
messy.rule: This weapon leaves unmistakable residue, damage, or biological evidence. Concealing that a confrontation occurred is normally impossible without extensive cleanup.

mind-link.name: Mind Link
mind-link.rule: This Psionic weapon may target a creature the wielder is aware of within range even without line of sight.

mind-lock.name: Mind-Lock
mind-lock.rule: When this weapon causes a target to mark Stress, that target makes a Presence Reaction Roll against the weapon’s Feature DC. On a failure, it may only Move on its next Spotlight. Resistance: Presence vs Feature DC.

mounted-or-crew-served.name: Mounted or Crew-Served
mounted-or-crew-served.rule: This weapon operates in one of two modes:

neural-link.name: Neural-Link
neural-link.rule: Requires a neural-interface augmentation. Without one, attacks with the item have Disadvantage. It grants no extra Action and never controls its user.

non-lethal.name: Non-Lethal
non-lethal.rule: This weapon cannot reduce a target below 1 HP. Targets reduced to 1 HP by Non-Lethal weapons are Incapacitated (unconscious or helpless) but not dying.

obscuring.name: Obscuring
obscuring.rule: The grenade creates a cloud of dense smoke (or similar obscurant) that fills its blast radius. Creatures inside the cloud have total concealment from creatures outside, and vice versa. Attacks through or within the cloud suffer Disadvantage. Creatures without alternative senses (thermal, sonar, etc.) are effectively blind while inside.

one-shot.name: One-Shot
one-shot.rule: The item or payload is expended after the Action resolves, whether it succeeds or fails. Replenishment requires a new item or Downtime reload; matched dice do not change consumption.

one-use.name: One-Use
one-use.rule: The item or payload is expended after the Action resolves, whether it succeeds or fails. Replenishment requires a new item or Downtime reload; matched dice do not change consumption.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.rule: Before making an attack, you can mark 1 Stress to add +1d6 to damage if you hit. If you miss, the weapon degrades one step on the adopted Condition Track; if that optional module is inactive, it goes offline until an Action and Knowledge (Tech) Roll, DC 10, restores it.

overheating.name: Overheating
overheating.rule: After each attack, roll d6. On 1-2, either mark 1 Stress to force cooling or spend an Action cooling before the weapon can attack again.

paired.name: Paired
paired.rule: When wielding two weapons that both have Paired, add the listed Paired bonus from one of them to the damage of an attack made with either weapon. Only one Paired bonus applies per attack.

penetrating.name: Penetrating
penetrating.rule: The projectile passes through targets and cover. If the attack hits, the projectile continues in a straight line and may strike additional targets behind the first. Roll separate attack rolls for each target in the line of fire (up to 3 targets). Each subsequent target takes -1d6 damage as the projectile loses energy.

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.rule: This is Lingering (3 rounds). It uses the same Area Reaction, once-per-Spotlight limit, and visible duration marker.

phasing.name: Phasing
phasing.rule: The weapon deals Void damage, ignores cover on ranged attacks, and ignores one Armor Slot on a hit. Its Void damage also applies the normal -4 Threshold Penetration. A Void Ward cancels the Penetration but not the ignored Armor Slot unless it explicitly cancels the whole feature.

plague.name: Plague
plague.rule: Descriptive payload class only. The specific item must define exposure, Reaction Roll, DC, effect, duration, and treatment; otherwise this tag has no mechanical effect.

poison.name: Poison
poison.rule: When the attack causes HP loss, the target marks 1 Stress. A Poison (Special) item replaces this effect with its own text.

power-hungry.name: Power-Hungry
power-hungry.rule: The weapon requires significant power to operate. Options include:

powerful.name: Powerful
powerful.rule: This weapon’s listed damage die is one size larger than the standard die for its chassis. The damage line already includes this increase.

precursor.name: Precursor
precursor.rule: Legal, origin, and portrayal classifications only. They have no unstated mechanical effect.

probability-shift.name: Probability Shift
probability-shift.rule: After rolling the attack, you may reroll both Duality Dice. You must use the new result.

prototype.name: Prototype
prototype.rule: Legal, origin, and portrayal classifications only. They have no unstated mechanical effect.

psionic.name: Psionic
psionic.rule: This weapon makes no attack roll against Evasion. Instead the target makes a Presence Reaction Roll against the item’s Feature DC; on a failure it takes the weapon’s damage in full, and on a success it takes none. Wards and effects that block Veil contact block the attack outright. Resistance: Presence vs Feature DC.

pull.name: Pull
pull.rule: After blast damage resolves, every creature that failed the Blast Reaction moves to the center of the zone and becomes Prone. A creature that succeeded does not move and makes no second Roll.

quick.name: Quick
quick.rule: After attacking, mark 1 Stress to immediately make a second attack against the same target.

range.name: Range
range.rule: Range sets that personal weapon's maximum range to the named Core band.

reach.name: Reach
reach.rule: This Melee weapon may attack a target at the listed distance, normally Very Close, without entering Melee range.

reality-shift.name: Reality Shift
reality-shift.rule: After a hit but before damage is rolled, the wielder chooses Physical, Energy, Void, or Neural for that hit. This changes only the canonical type; tags, dice, Penetration, Conditions, and every other property remain as printed.

reliable.name: Reliable
reliable.rule: Gain +1 on all attack rolls made with this weapon.

reload.name: Reload
reload.rule: After each shot, spend an Action reloading before the weapon can attack again.

restricted.name: Restricted
restricted.rule: Legal, origin, and portrayal classifications only. They have no unstated mechanical effect.

returning.name: Returning
returning.rule: If thrown, the weapon returns to the user's hand at the end of the current Spotlight. If a barrier blocks the path, it stops at that barrier; calling it from a clear path later is a Maneuver.

salvo-fire.name: Salvo Fire
salvo-fire.rule: After a successful attack, mark 1 Stress to apply the same attack result to a second target within Close of the primary target. Roll damage separately.

scatter.name: Scatter
scatter.rule: At Very Close range, attack rolls gain +1 and damage rolls gain +2. At Close range or beyond, attack rolls suffer -1.

scope.name: Scope
scope.rule: When you spend an Action to Aim before firing this weapon, gain +2 to the attack roll instead of the standard +1. Additionally, reduce range penalties by one band (a penalty for firing at Very Far is treated as Far, Far as Close, and so on).

self-repairing.name: Self-Repairing
self-repairing.rule: During any Long Rest, this weapon automatically improves one step on the adopted Condition Track, to a minimum of Worn; it cannot self-repair from Broken. If that optional module is inactive, this property has no mechanical effect.

sensor-block.name: Sensor-Block
sensor-block.rule: In addition to visual obscurement, this smoke blocks thermal imaging, radar, and most electronic sensors. Creatures with technological augmented senses (cybernetic eyes, sensor suites) gain no benefit against this obscurement.

set.name: Set
set.rule: When an enemy enters this weapon's reach during their movement, you may make an immediate attack against them as a Reaction. If this attack hits, add +1d6 to damage.

shaped.name: Shaped
shaped.rule: The explosive force is directed in a specific direction rather than expanding spherically. Creatures and objects behind the charge (the target side) take full damage. Creatures and objects in front of or beside the charge take no damage from the blast (though secondary effects like debris may still apply).

shield.name: Shield
shield.rule: This item can be used with class features and abilities that reference shields. It provides partial cover (+2 to Evasion) against ranged attacks from one direction while wielded.

shield-piercing.name: Shield Piercing
shield-piercing.rule: Only half of the target’s available Armor Slots, rounded down, may be spent against this hit.

shred.name: Shred
shred.rule: After the attack causes HP loss, reduce the target's maximum Armor Slots by 1 until Repair All Armor and apply Bleeding to an organic target. A single hit applies this once.

shredding.name: Shredding
shredding.rule: When the attack causes HP loss, reduce the target’s maximum Armor Slots by 1 until the armor is repaired during Downtime.

silent.name: Silent
silent.rule: Using this weapon creates no report or muzzle flash and does not automatically break stealth or alert creatures beyond the immediate victim.

singularity.name: Singularity
singularity.rule: Choose a point at Far range. Creatures within Close of it make a Strength Reaction Roll against the item’s Feature DC; on a failure they are pulled toward the point and Restrained (Chapter 10). Resistance: Strength vs Feature DC.

smart.name: Smart
smart.rule: The missile has onboard targeting AI and its attack has Advantage against a moving vehicle. When targeted, that vehicle's operator may use their Reaction and make a Finesse (Pilot/Navigate) Roll, DC 20; success cancels that Advantage. The attack still rolls against Evasion and never hits automatically. This personal/vehicle guidance is not a starship Sensor Lock.

smart-scope.name: Smart Scope
smart-scope.rule: Gain +2 on attack rolls at Far or Very Far range.

spray.name: Spray
spray.rule: Instead of targeting a single enemy, your attack affects all creatures in a cone (Very Close range, 60-degree arc). Roll once; apply the result to all targets in the cone.

stable.name: Stable
stable.rule: This weapon ignores Overheating and other sustained-use malfunctions unless a rule explicitly overrides Stable.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.rule: A target damaged by this weapon has Disadvantage on its next action.

structural.name: Structural
structural.rule: Designed to destroy buildings, bridges, and infrastructure. When placed on load-bearing elements (support columns, foundation points, key structural members), the charge causes catastrophic structural failure in addition to direct blast damage. A properly placed structural charge can collapse a small building, drop a bridge span, or seal a tunnel.

stunning.name: Stunning
stunning.rule: A damaged target makes a Strength Reaction Roll against the item’s Feature DC. On a failure it is Stunned (Chapter 10). Resistance: Strength vs Feature DC.

stunning-on-crit.name: Stunning on crit
stunning-on-crit.rule: On a Critical Hit, the target is Stunned (Chapter 10).

sundering.name: Sundering
sundering.rule: After a Critical Success attack causes HP loss, the target's player chooses one: a fictionally exposed held shield goes offline, or maximum Armor Slots fall by 2, minimum 0, until Repair All Armor. Restore an offline ordinary shield during a Short or Long Rest with suitable tools and Knowledge (Tech), DC 15. A signature or bonded shield goes offline rather than being destroyed.

suppressive.name: Suppressive
suppressive.rule: Mark 1 Stress. Every creature within Close of the target has Disadvantage on attacks until the end of its next Spotlight. This rides along with a normal attack; it is not the Suppress action (Chapter 10), which costs your whole Spotlight but hobbles every action in the area rather than attacks alone.

sustained-fire.name: Sustained Fire
sustained-fire.rule: After you hit a target, you may maintain the beam. On your next Spotlight, if you have not moved, the target remains within range, and it does not have total cover, spend your Action to deal the same rolled damage to that target without a new attack roll. You may continue maintaining the beam under the same conditions.

system-shock.name: System Shock
system-shock.rule: Against Synthetics and machines, deal normal damage. Against organic targets, deal only 1d4 Stress. If any damage die rolls its maximum and the attack causes HP or Stress loss, the target's player chooses one fictionally exposed electronic device; it goes offline until an Action and a Knowledge (Tech) Roll, DC 10, restores it. The Keeper chooses for an NPC. This damage-die trigger never alters the Duality result.

taser-charge.name: Taser Charge
taser-charge.rule: The target makes a Strength Reaction Roll against the item’s Feature DC. On a failure it is Stunned (Chapter 10). Resistance: Strength vs Feature DC.

temporal.name: Temporal
temporal.rule: Once per scene after making a nonmatching attack Roll with this weapon, reroll the Hope die and use the new face. The reroll may create a Critical Success. A matched result is already a Critical Success and cannot be rerolled by this property.

thermal.name: Thermal
thermal.rule: A damaged target makes a Strength Reaction Roll against the weapon's Feature DC. On failure, apply the Core On Fire condition.

thrown.name: Thrown
thrown.rule: Thrown permits a Finesse or Instinct ranged attack to the named band. After resolution the weapon lies in the target's zone and may be retrieved as part of a later Action after reaching it.

torture.name: Torture
torture.rule: This weapon is designed to cause maximum pain. Evidence of its use generates additional Heat (+1) and may constitute a war crime.

two-handed.name: Two-Handed
two-handed.rule: Two-Handed requires both hands; while either hand is occupied by another object, the weapon cannot attack.

unraveling.name: Unraveling
unraveling.rule: When any damage die rolls its maximum value, a player target chooses one Class or Ancestry Feature to suppress until the end of the scene; the Keeper chooses for an NPC. The target keeps control of all decisions and cannot lose its Path resource engine.

unstable.name: Unstable
unstable.rule: On a Failure with Fear attack with the weapon, the wielder marks 1 Stress. The weapon also degrades one step on the adopted Condition Track; if that optional module is inactive, it goes offline until an Action and Knowledge (Tech) Roll, DC 10, restores it. Matching dice remain Critical Success.

untraceable.name: Untraceable
untraceable.rule: This weapon leaves no ballistic evidence. Shots cannot be traced to the weapon.

unwieldy.name: Unwieldy
unwieldy.rule: Attacks with this weapon take -2 unless the wielder spent an Action to brace it after their previous Spotlight and has not moved since. The brace ends after the weapon attacks or the wielder moves.

vibration.name: Vibration
vibration.rule: Armor Slots cannot be spent to reduce this instance of damage.

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.rule: On Failure with Fear while attacking, the weapon overheats and cannot attack until an Action cools it. The wielder makes an Agility Reaction Roll, DC 10; on failure take 1d6 Energy damage with the Fire tag. Matching dice never trigger it.

waveform.name: Waveform
waveform.rule: The attack affects every creature in a Close-range cone. Roll once and compare the result with each target's Evasion.
